title: Vice President, Supply Chain
personalisation_hook: He is roughly six weeks into the VP Supply Chain seat - the single best-timed conversation on this list. Pair it with Deere's $140M IT spend on parts distribution.
recommended_opening_line: Congratulations on the move to VP Supply Chain at Deere - with the $140M IT investment going into parts distribution and TMC running managed transportation on Navisphere, I imagine your first 90 days include a hard look at where transportation decisions actually get made.

title: Vice President Supply Chain Strategy and Engineering
personalisation_hook: He personally presented on supply chain consolidation at RILA, and Lowe's is mid-flight on a RELEX planning rollout landing early 2027 - planning is being modernised while execution still sits on a Blue Yonder-era TMS tenant.
recommended_opening_line: Your RILA session on supply chain consolidation stuck with me, particularly because Lowe's is unifying forecasting, replenishment and allocation on RELEX by early 2027 while execution still runs through a Blue Yonder-era TMS.

title: SVP Supply Chain: North America Transformation
personalisation_hook: PepsiCo's own live transportation job req names Blue Yonder TMS (ex-JDA) and asks for eight years of hands-on experience on it - a legacy platform being staffed rather than replaced, inside the transformation he leads.
recommended_opening_line: PepsiCo's open Deputy Director Transportation req asks for eight-plus years on Blue Yonder TMS - formerly JDA - which is a striking requirement to be writing in 2026 inside a North America transformation you're leading.

title: Vice President, IT - Device Assembly and Packaging, Global Supply Chain, MES and Engineering
personalisation_hook: Lilly and Infosys are actively staffing a full-lifecycle SAP TM implementation with TM-EWM integration at the same time Lilly is standing up Regional Transportation Hubs and a Cold Chain Transportation COE.
recommended_opening_line: Lilly and Infosys are staffing a full-lifecycle SAP TM build with TM-EWM integration while a separate Cold Chain Transportation COE stands up Regional Transportation Hubs - two programmes that have to meet somewhere in your estate.

title: Global Head of ERP Architecture and Platform
personalisation_hook: He personally published 'We are live on S/4 HANA!' at Ford, and Ford's supply chain technology lead is now publicly describing TMS modernisation on top of that ERP foundation.
recommended_opening_line: You wrote 'We are live on S/4 HANA!' for Ford in 2021, and Subhasish Roychoudhury is now publicly describing TMS modernisation and agentic AI on top of that foundation - I'd like your read on where the transport layer should actually sit.

title: Vice President, Global Supply Chain Strategy and Operations
personalisation_hook: He is co-designing a supply chain master's programme with Temple Fox while running Pfizer hospital supply - he is unusually willing to talk publicly about how supply chain work is changing.
recommended_opening_line: You told Temple Fox last October that 'we see a critical need for Temple and Fox to fill this gap' on supply chain skills - a similar gap shows up in transport execution, where Pfizer's control towers can see shipments the systems still can't act on.

title: VP, SAP & Supply Chain Systems, Loblaw Technology & Analytics
personalisation_hook: She owns both SAP and supply chain systems at Loblaw while the company runs 50 Gatik autonomous trucks and a legacy Blue Yonder SCPO/JDA planning estate - one person sitting on both sides of that seam.
recommended_opening_line: You own both the SAP and supply chain systems side at Loblaw while Gatik scales to 50 autonomous trucks across the GTA and planning still runs on Blue Yonder SCPO - that seam between autonomous execution and legacy planning is exactly what I want to ask you about.

title: Director, Supply Chain Optimization
personalisation_hook: Dollar General has an open 'IT Analyst - Implementation I (Transportation Management System)' req in Goodlettsville dated August 2026 - a TMS implementation is underway right now.
recommended_opening_line: Dollar General posted an IT Analyst - Implementation role for a Transportation Management System in Goodlettsville this month, which suggests a TMS implementation is live - I wanted to ask what you're optimising around while that lands.

title: Executive Director, Supply Chain Strategy and PMO
personalisation_hook: He is on the RILA LINK2026 committee, and CVS's own open Lead Director req names MercuryGate and Omnitracs as the TMS layer beneath Manhattan Active and Blue Yonder.
recommended_opening_line: CVS's open Lead Director, Supply Chain Systems req in Woonsocket lists MercuryGate and Omnitracs under Manhattan Active and Blue Yonder - four systems for one product flow is the kind of problem your PMO ends up owning.

title: Vice President Supply Chain Management
personalisation_hook: He is on camera as an ArrowStream reference customer and his title and direct email are printed in a public Virginia Tech contract - one of the few prospects here whose contact details are independently verified.
recommended_opening_line: You're on record as an ArrowStream reference customer for PFG, and PFG's Gilroy DC pairs emissions-free transportation with refrigeration - both of which put a lot of weight on how well transport execution and data actually talk to each other.

title: Director of Architecture / Engineering, Supply Chain Solutions
personalisation_hook: He owns supply chain architecture at a distributor whose routing stack was built on Descartes Routing/Mobile/Telematics as a single-vendor fleet solution, with Oracle Cloud ERP underneath.
recommended_opening_line: Ferguson went to Descartes for routing, mobile and telematics specifically to get a comprehensive fleet solution from one vendor - as the architecture owner, I'd like your view on whether that single-vendor logic still holds now that Oracle Cloud ERP sits underneath.
